kicker: Sakana Fugu, TRINITY and the Conductor

scenes.headline: How a learned coordinator turns many models into one
scenes.sub: Sakana Fugu, and the two papers underneath it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Stratus! No single model wins everywhere. Sakana's bet: stop picking one, and learn to run a whole pool of them.

scenes.text: Behind one endpoint, a learned coordinator assembles a team from a pool of frontier and open models. The orchestration itself becomes the model.
scenes.mark: The orchestration itself becomes the model
scenes.say: Behind one endpoint, a learned coordinator assembles a team from a pool of frontier and open models. The orchestration itself becomes the model.

scenes.title: One endpoint, a pool behind it

steps.say: You call one endpoint, as if it were one model.
Behind it, a coordinator picks models from the pool and runs them over several turns.
One answer comes back. The coordinator is learned, and two papers learn it in opposite ways.

scenes.title: TRINITY picks an agent and a role

steps.say: A small frozen model reads the transcript. A linear head of about ten thousand parameters turns its hidden state into a choice.
Which model acts, and in which role. A Thinker plans, a Worker does the work, a Verifier checks.
It loops until a Verifier accepts. With a binary reward, the head is trained by evolution, not gradients.

scenes.title: The Conductor writes three lists
scenes.say: The Conductor goes big: a seven-billion-parameter model, trained with reinforcement learning, writes the workflow itself.

items.say: what each step is told to do,

items.text: Which earlier outputs each step reads
items.say: and which earlier outputs each step may read. That list designs the topology: a chain, parallel branches, or verify and merge.

items.text: It can name itself as a worker
items.say: It can even call itself, spawning a sub-workflow on its own draft.

scenes.title: LiveCodeBench v6, pass@1 (%)
scenes.say: Transferred to held-out tasks, the evolved coordinator beat every model in its own pool: eighty-six point two on LiveCodeBench.

scenes.text: Coordination is now a trainable layer that sits above frontier models, rather than inside one.

recap: One endpoint coordinates a pool of models
TRINITY evolves a tiny agent-and-role picker
The Conductor writes workflows as three lists
scenes.say: To recap: one endpoint over a pool, a tiny evolved picker, and a model that writes the workflow.
